name: OSV.dev
summary: Open source vulnerabilities by package and version, commit hash or ID (GHSA, PYSEC, RUSTSEC, Go, OSS-Fuzz and more) in the OSV format, from Google's free OSV.dev API.
notes: Keyless and, per the docs, currently without rate limits. Responses over HTTP/1.1 are capped at 32 MiB; HTTP/2 has no cap.
Queries are reads sent as POST with a JSON body. Values are case-sensitive: ecosystem 'PyPI', not 'pypi'.
Give the version either in version or in a versioned purl (pkg:pypi/jinja2@3.1.4), never both: that is a 400.

endpoints.name: Find vulnerabilities for a package version or commit
endpoints.summary: Full OSV records affecting one package at one version, or one commit.

package.description: The package: {name, ecosystem} (ecosystem names are case-sensitive, e.g. PyPI, npm, Go, Maven, RubyGems, crates.io, GIT) or {purl}. Optional when commit is given.

version.description: Version string, fuzzy-matched against upstream versions. Do not combine with commit or a versioned purl.

commit.description: Commit hash to query instead of a version.

notes: Pages when over 1,000 vulnerabilities or 20 seconds: repeat with page_token until next_page_token is gone.

endpoints.name: Find vulnerabilities for many packages at once
endpoints.summary: Vulnerability IDs and modified times for up to 1,000 package versions or commits, in input order.

queries.description: List of query objects, each shaped like the query endpoint's body ({package, version} or {commit}, optional page_token).

notes: A read over POST. Returns only id and modified per vulnerability; fetch details with vulns.get.
Per-query next_page_token appears when one query exceeds 1,000 results or the batch exceeds 3,000; re-query just those.

endpoints.name: Get a vulnerability by ID
endpoints.summary: The full OSV record: summary, details, aliases, affected packages and ranges, severity, references.
